The cartographer had never seen the coast she drew. She worked from letters, thousands of them, each describing a single cove or headland from the inside of someone's longing.

She did not mind that the map was secondhand. Every map is.

On the last page she drew a lighthouse, though no letter had mentioned one, because a coast this carefully described deserved a light.
